premises.text: Software built by a grower for growers captures vital farm labor data (who/what/when/where) digitally
premises.evidence_span: it was built by a grower for growers, by a farmer for farmers. And that makes it one of a kind. The other thing is that AgriTrack captures the most vital data that farmers need, which is labor

premises.text: H-2A seasonal labor programs impose heavy paperwork and compliance tracking of person and place
premises.evidence_span: the H-2A program is a government program that helps U.S. farms get seasonal labor from other countries. And without this program, farmers can't survive because they have no labor. But being that it's a government program, it's also heavily regulated. And with heavy regulations comes heavy paperwork

premises.text: Most farms still use pen-and-paper tracking, making DOL compliance hard (high audit violation rates)
premises.evidence_span: 84% of farms today are still tracking everything with pen and paper. They haven't digitized yet. And that's a completely impractical way of doing it, obviously. And it's really difficult to stay compliant when you're recording everything with pen and paper

premises.text: Three apps (dashboard, field tablet with NFC clock-in, phone with geotag) digitize labor inputs for managers
premises.evidence_span: Agritrack accomplishes this in three different apps. One is a dashboard app, which is a high level view of the farm in real time for farmers and managers

premises.text: Labor audit report packages DOL-ready compliance documentation for download
premises.evidence_span: the labor audit report. It's named that way for a reason, because it has everything that's in step with the Department of Labor and what they need if they come and audit a farm

premises.text: System calculates complex hour/piece-rate/overtime payroll correctly and much faster
premises.evidence_span: Good news with AgriTrack is that we handle all that for them, so that they know that when they do payroll, it's accurate

domains.name: H-2A compliance and paper tracking problem

value.text: Farms gain accurate digitized labor data and DOL-ready compliance confidence
value.evidence_span: farms can utilize AgriTrack to have confidence in the data that they're collecting, knowing that it's accurate, and that if the Department of Labor comes knocking, they feel okay

causal_links.evidence_span: it's really difficult to stay compliant when you're recording everything with pen and paper
AgriTrack helps solve this problem by digitizing the whole process
